publication_revisions.abstract: Here we report the ATLAS discovery of the transient ATLAS25fyr (AT2025nat) in galaxy NGC 4475 at magnitude m_o = 18.36 +/- 0.12. At a distance of 105 Mpc (redshift independent, from NED), the transient was discovered on MJD = 60833.32 (2025-06-07.32) with an absolute magnitude of M = -16.8 +/- 0.2. The last non-detection through forced photometry was on MJD = 60829.34. Forced photometry indicates that the transient is rising. Spectroscopic classification is encouraged.
